answer: The defence here is IPsec certificate per identity: one key, one proof, and no shortcut around it. An honest agent spends 18 minutes once; the operator of 704 fakes spends 12672 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. One inlet of signal, one garden of cost, one walnut of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
